d.seg: कोई बात नहीं आप इंस्टाग्राम पे आ सकते हो मेरे नाम क्या है इंस्टाग्राम
d.tr: No problem, can you come on Instagram? What is your Instagram name?
d.ctx: The user asks the expert to move the conversation to Instagram. The expert initially questions this.
d.j: The user is proposing to move the conversation to an external app (Instagram).

d.seg: मैं बोल रहा हूँ ना किसी चीज़ का कमी नहीं होगा आपकी तो आ जाओ ना इंस्टा पे आ जाओ वहीं बात करेंगे
d.tr: I am telling you, you won't lack anything, so come on Insta, we will talk there.
d.ctx: The user insists on moving to Instagram after the expert expresses hesitation.
d.j: The user is actively proposing to move the conversation to an external app.

d.seg: प्रिया राज प्रिया राज प्रिया राज डबल एट डबल जीरो
d.tr: Priya Raj Priya Raj Priya Raj double eight double zero
d.ctx: The user provides their Instagram handle/ID details to the expert.
d.j: The user is providing a social media handle to move the conversation off-platform.

d.seg: कॉइन ऐड करके आइए ओके कॉइन कॉइन ऐड करके आइए मुझे कॉल कीजिए इसको फिर
d.tr: Come after adding coins, okay, add coins and call me again on this.
d.ctx: The user is asking the expert to add coins to the app to continue the call.
d.j: The user is pressuring the expert to pay/add coins to continue the interaction, which is a form of suspicious activity regarding platform payments.
